title: Microsoft Copilot: new rich answer cards for weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news
summary: Hold: the web search control's UI link does not document the setting at the end of the printed path. The automation also omits a prerequisite that makes it fail when the same setting is configured in a group-level policy. The roadmap facts and the distinction from the earlier Bing answer cards are supported.

claims.claim: The release notes for 21 April 2026 describe Bing web answer cards such as Weather and Stocks under separate roadmap item 500865.
claims.quote:
## April 21, 2026
Rich Bing web answer cards in Copilot Chat [Windows, Web]
Microsoft 365 Copilot now displays rich, interactive Bing web answer cards-such as Weather and Stocks-directly in chat responses
Roadmap ID: 500865

claims.claim: Whether item 567008 uses the same Bing source as item 500865 is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot rich answer cards weather sports finance places news Bing source organizational data MSA users admin roles license credit meter'; read web search and searched release notes for 567008; Bing card documentation names 500865, not 567008.

claims.claim: When Copilot searches the web, it sends a generated query to the Bing search service.
claims.quote: Based on these terms, Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information.

claims.claim: A Copilot web search request also sends the user's client IP address to Bing.
claims.quote: When Copilot sends a web search request to the Bing search service, it also sends the user's client IP address, which Bing uses to help localize results, such as nearby weather and events.

claims.claim: The Data Protection Addendum does not apply to generated web search queries.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum (DPA) doesn't apply to the use of generated web search queries in Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Chat, or the Bing search service.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 Apps admin center path reaches Allow web search in Copilot and its docs link documents the control's own steps.
claims.quote: On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration. You can search for the policy by name, or you can create a custom filter.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].ui.docs and the rendered UI Learn link to https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/manage-public-web-access, which names Allow web search in Copilot and links to Cloud Policy. Keep overview-cloud-policy in sources for the route into the configuration; the current docs page never names the final setting.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors with mode applyOnce applies the web search baseline, with only the tenant-level restriction stated.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.
claims.fix: Keep the API call. Add to controls[0].note and the TCM paragraph: 'Before using TCM, ensure Allow web search in Copilot is not configured in any group-level policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center; otherwise monitoring, snapshots, remediation and applyOnce fail for this resource.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources.

claims.claim: The allowwebsearch resource accepts value 0, 1 or 2.
claims.quote: 0 enables it in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. 1 disables it in both. 2 disables it in Microsoft 365 Copilot Work mode while enabling it in Microsoft 365 Copilot Web mode and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.
